lines.t:
The <c:ffff00>{{medabot}}<c> chosen in each <c:ffff00>{{robattle}}<c> as the team's
boss.
If the {{leader}} is <c:ffff00>{{knocked_out}}<c>, the team loses
regardless of the state of the other {{medabot|pl}}.

Only the {{leader}} has certain privileges: the <c:ffff00>{{leader}}<c>
<c:ffff00>{{effect}}<c> of its <c:ffff00>{{medal}}<c> activates and, with an EX <c:ffff00>{{part}}<c> set
up in advance, it can swap {{part|pl}} during the {{robattle}}
(<c:ffff00>{{trans_part}}<c>).
